security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A simple, playful DAW for the Steam Deck
bundle.longDescription: Layer any audio, cut and split clips, record from the mic, and add iZotope-style reverb and voice FX — wrapped in retro pixel/DOOM art. Built for the Steam Deck in desktop mode.
